# Ward International Lawyers

> Panama law firm for international companies and investors. Complex litigation, corporate, maritime and immigration law. Service in English, Spanish and German.

Panamanian law firm in Costa del Este, Panama City (Financial Park, 17th floor). Core practices: complex litigation and corporate law / international business. Also: local counsel for foreign law firms, maritime law and ship registration, immigration and relocation, labor law for companies, real estate and condominium (horizontal property) law. Languages: Spanish, English, German.

Contact: WhatsApp/phone (507) 6505-4281, jward@wardintlawyers.com.

## Practice areas
- [Complex litigation](https://wardintlawyers.com/en/complex-litigation/): High-stakes civil, commercial, criminal and maritime cases, arbitration and mediation.
- [Corporate law](https://wardintlawyers.com/en/corporate-law/): Companies, foundations, bank accounts, contracts, M&A and ongoing counsel.
- [Local counsel for law firms](https://wardintlawyers.com/en/panama-co-counsel/): Local counsel for foreign law firms: litigation, due diligence and filings.
- [Maritime law](https://wardintlawyers.com/en/maritime-law/): Ship flagging, title registration, naval mortgages, licenses and concessions.
- [Immigration & relocation](https://wardintlawyers.com/en/immigration-relocation/): Residency, work permits, naturalization and relocation of families and staff.
- [Labor law](https://wardintlawyers.com/en/labor-law/): Contracts, payroll, terminations, conciliation and labor litigation.
- [Real estate](https://wardintlawyers.com/en/real-estate/): Property purchases, title review and the condominium regime.
